note: McLeod County publishes its zoning districts only as a static 2017 PDF map (prepared by County GIS). Its GeoMoose interactive viewer (gis.mcleodcountymn.gov, HeiGeo) exposes parcel mapping and no queryable zoning service was found; no ArcGIS REST zoning layer exists on the county's hub, MnGeo, or ArcGIS Online. Cities checked: Hutchinson publishes a 2024 zoning PDF, Glencoe a code PDF and map on its site, Winsted a 2017 zoning map (PDF). A generic 'Zoning_Districts' FeatureServer found on ArcGIS Online (services.arcgis.com/f4rR7WnIfGBdVYFd) is not McLeod (no features in the county bounding box; its codes are a different city's chapter scheme).
